items.title: US says Iran seeking 'exit ramp' despite mixed ceasefire signals
items.description: The White House says talks with Iran aimed at ending the conflict have not stalled, despite conflicting reports on Iran's response to a 15-point ceasefire proposal.

items.title: TGA releases proposed reforms to Australian sunscreen regulation
items.description: The proposals include a number of potential changes to SPF testing requirements for sunscreens listed for sale in Australia.

items.title: Live: Australia, Germany to sign status of forces agreement
items.description: Australia and Germany will sign a status of forces agreement and enter a pact for space cooperation. Follow live.

items.title: Why you should take Trump with a ladle of salt, plus what else to know today
items.description: Both the Trump administration and the Iranian regime have their own unique ways of expressing themselves — and both are prone to hyperbole, says Mark Doran in Beirut.

items.title: Live: Trump says Iran 'afraid' to admit it wants a deal as US sends in more troops
items.description: Donald Trump claims Iranian leaders are afraid to admit they are negotiating with the US, with the Pentagon confirming the deployment of more ground troops to the Middle East. Follow live.

items.title: PM calls second emergency national cabinet meeting over fuel crisis
items.description: States and territory leaders will convene next week to further coordinate the national response to the fuel crisis as the fallout from the Iran war continues to escalate.

items.title: WA Coral Coast on alert as Cyclone Narelle intensifies
items.description: The extreme weather system is steadily intensifying as it tracks towards the West Australian coast.

items.title: Seasons clash as polar blast joins summer cyclone on Australia's weather map
items.description: A clash of seasons is developing on Australia's weather map this week as a tropical cyclone tracks towards the WA west coast and a polar blast with thunderstorms forms over the south-east.

items.title: Meta and Google found liable in landmark social media addiction lawsuit
items.description: The case was brought on by a 20-year-old woman who accused the tech companies of causing harm by deliberately designing addictive platforms which worsened her mental health.

items.title: 'Here I am': Sarah Mullally enthroned as first female Archbishop of Canterbury
items.description: Dame Sarah Mullally is enthroned as the Church of England's first female Archbishop of Canterbury, taking the helm as the spiritual leader of 85 million Anglicans worldwide in a historic ceremony blending tradition with global symbolism.

items.title: We've been here before as global crises tend to follow a predictable path

items.title: Hard time for renters as landlords squeeze tight market
items.description: Australian renters continue to have a hard time finding a home, despite vacancy rates slowly improving from post COVID pandemic lows, a report finds.

items.title: The $88 million question facing Kyle Sandilands and radio network ARN
items.description: There's an $88 million question doing the rounds of legal and media circles, after the catastrophic falling-out between radio shock jocks Kyle and Jackie O and their former radio network ARN.

items.title: Savannah Guthrie gives first interview since mother's disappearance

items.title: Hannah Gadsby, Aaron Chen and more share their picks of the comedy festival
items.description: Comedy season is in full swing, with festivals across the country hosting the best acts from Australia and the world. We asked our favourites to share their recommendations.

items.title: What should you eat to keep your brain sharp as you get older?
items.description: The food choices we make over decades — not just in later life, but across adulthood — may quietly shape the health of our brains in ways that only become visible much later.

items.title: ABC Shakespeare quiz, parteth the seceund: Test thine knowledge once more
items.description: Is this a quiz which you see before you?  We're back with another 10 questions to test your knowledge of William Shakespeare's plays.

items.title: Man dubbed 'miracle baby' when he was born dies aged 33

items.title: Controversial Melbourne nightclub Love Machine destroyed by fire

items.title: Bay the 'greatest risk and biggest asset' for beachside residents in Victoria

items.title: Brisbane capitalises on 'less sexy' business events to the tune of millions
